Bridgeview is an MLS® area in northwest Surrey, near the Fraser River and Scott Road SkyTrain Station. The City calls it a historic neighbourhood. Bridgeview Park and the Bridgeview Community Centre are at its heart.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 13, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Surrey and Surrey Schools.
General information only.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

Where is Bridgeview?

Bridgeview is an MLS® area name in Surrey. On the MLS® map it runs in northwest Surrey near the Fraser River and Scott Road Station, with many homes along 124 Street around 105 Avenue. Bolivar Heights and Whalley are close by on some of the same streets. These edges are approximate and are not an official City boundary, so ask me if a specific address is in it.
How do I get around from Bridgeview?
Scott Road Station
on the Expo Line is close by. The R6 RapidBus runs from Scott Road Station to Newton Exchange.
The
runs between Scott Road Station and Surrey Central Station on Bridgeview streets, including Bridgeview Drive, 115 Avenue, 114 Avenue and 112 Avenue.
Scott Road Station is also served by the 312, 319, 321, 391, 640 and N19.
Which school is in Bridgeview?

Bridgeview Elementary (kindergarten to grade 7) is at 12834 115A Avenue. It is in the Kwantlen Park Secondary family of schools, with Forsyth Road, James Ardiel, KB Woodward, Old Yale Road, Surrey Traditional and Theresa Clarke. Check the
Surrey Schools School Locator
for an exact address.
